capabilities: Adjust global font size from status bar buttons or commands
Toggle light/dark theme and cycle source, live preview, and reading modes
Enter focus or zen mode that hides sidebars, ribbon, and other UI
Delete a note together with its linked images after scanning for shared usage
Reopen recently opened notes from a history modal
disambiguation: Not a file viewer or reader app; it controls Obsidian's own interface elements from the status bar.
extras: Installation is manual (download release files into the plugins folder); the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian buries font size, theme switching, editor mode, and UI-hiding controls in settings and menus, with no quick one-click access from the status bar or on mobile.

relations.evidence: If you use the Homepage plugin and your homepage is a note, that note is pinned

summary: Status bar utility that adjusts font size, toggles themes and focus modes, cycles editor modes, and manages recent notes and note deletion.
